title: Joint Business Holders: Rights and Responsibilities of Each Holder
summary: Explains the rights and responsibilities of joint business holders, including access to account info/notifications, ability to initiate actions per permissions, and approval workflow participation. It specifies dual authorization triggers when transactions meet or exceed $25,000, plus credential/security, segregation of duties, governance procedures, and evidence retention.
faqs: What account information and notifications can each joint business holder access?
What responsibilities does each holder have for business/personal information accuracy and security credentials?
When are dual authorizations required for joint business holder transactions?
What is the $25,000 trigger amount for additional approvals, and what actions does it affect?
What governance procedures should be in place for who can initiate, review, and finalize account actions?
What approval evidence and policy acknowledgments must be retained for audits/regulatory requests?
keywords: Evidence of approvals and policy acknowledgments
